description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

description.zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个结果。
description.en: The interval for returning data. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 要查询的端口号。不传入该参数表示查询所有端口。
description.en: The number of port that you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all ports are queried.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

title.zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的端口连接数列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-conns-list --resource-group-id default --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --interval 1000 --port 80 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
